info.name: StockSense API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for all StockSense backend endpoints running on XAMPP (Apache + MySQL).

Features:
- Authentication (Signup, Login, Logout, Forgot/Reset Password)
- Profile & Shop Details Management
- User Settings & Theme Preferences
- Complete Inventory Management (CRUD, Search & Filter, Bulk Import)

variable.description: Auto-populated 64-char Bearer token from Login response

request.description: Inserts a new product into the shop inventory with duplicate SKU prevention.
Updates stock quantity (units), selling price, cost price, or threshold for an existing product.
Imports batch product data. Mode can be 'add_units' (increments existing units) or 'set_units' (overwrites stock count).
Deletes a product by SKU or ID, scoped strictly to the authenticated shop owner.

formdata.description: Select a .csv or .xlsx stock spreadsheet file (up to 5 MB)

request.description: Uploads a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) stock spreadsheet (up to 5 MB). Detects headers, generates initial 5-row preview, suggests 5-column mappings, and generates a session file_token.
Previews all mapped rows with current store stock levels, calculated selling price string, unit costs, and highlight indicators for potential errors before validation.

Validates every spreadsheet row. Detects stray letters (e.g. '18O' instead of 18), missing SKUs, or negative values. Returns detailed error badges, reasons, and suggested corrections. When all rows are valid, returns stock preview calculation (current + add = new stock) and inventory value to add.

Executes database transaction. Existing SKUs have their units incremented (stock receipt), new SKUs create new products. If any invalid rows remain and allow_partial is false, transaction rolls back completely (HTTP 422). Logs completed/failed import to import_history.
Fetches historical import logs for the authenticated store owner with file name, file size, status, total rows, success/failed count, and summary details.

Returns full dashboard overview for the authenticated store owner with default 30-day date range: active products count, total inventory value, low-stock count, out-of-stock count, slow-moving items, AI priorities, category breakdown, and last import metadata.
Returns dashboard summary filtered by custom 'from' and 'to' date range. Validates date formats and ordering.
Tests date range validation error (from > to). Expects HTTP 400.
Tests authentication requirement. Expects HTTP 401 Unauthorized when no token is supplied.
